newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-GUATEMALA WORLD CUP GAMES RESCHEDULED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GUATEMALA WORLD CUP GAMES RESCHEDULED.

text.p: Guatemala must play their remaining home World Cup qualifiers on neutral grounds in the wake of last month's Mateo Flores Stadium tragedy in which 84 fans died.
The game against Costa Rica , postponed because of the disaster, has been rescheduled for Los Angeles on November 24, FIFA said on Friday.
Guatemala also play Trinidad and Tobago in Los Angeles on December 8 and the United States in San Salvador on December 21.
FIFA ruled that Guatemala City's Mateo Flores Stadium cannot be used until further notice.
